source: TrustLensAI_FederatedLearning_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Federated RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Federated Learning pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.key_fields: client identity, attestation, trust checks, device tier, data-governance decl.
layers.ingested_by: L0 · Foundation & Integration → L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: on-device data stats, preprocessing (NO raw egress), non-egress attestation
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance
layers.notes: Feeds PV-05 (raw data never leaves client)

layers.key_fields: local update refs, local loss, on-device compute/energy
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry
layers.notes: Update refs only; raw data in-perimeter (on device)

layers.key_fields: DP clipping/noise, encryption, update masking
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: secure-agg protocol, round payloads, bandwidth, compression
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: aggregation (FedAvg/robust), global-model metrics, contributing updates
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: poisoning/backdoor/byzantine/sybil detection, robust-aggregation actions
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: global-model version, distribution to clients, round lineage
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: round scheduling, stragglers, dropout, drift, non-IID stats, completion
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L2 · Observability

layers.key_fields: per-client global vs local performance, personalization gain
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: per-client contribution, benefit, free-rider / incentive signals
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: cumulative DP ε/δ per client & federation, budget state
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: which updates contributed, aggregator config, per-round provenance
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: round latency, participation rate, aggregation throughput
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: onboarding coverage, registry & round lineage, residency, regulatory
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: registered federation, client registry & attestation, tenancy, residency zones
layers.ingested_by: Anchors identity, client registry & residency for all logs

layers.key_fields: normalized FL spans/events (update refs, not raw data), redaction, event-bus
layers.ingested_by: Consumes all FL product logs; normalizes; raw data never ingested

layers.key_fields: reconstructed round/orchestration traces, dependency views, time-series
layers.ingested_by: Consumes canonical events (D1-gated / target)

layers.key_fields: evaluator outputs, global/convergence/personalization/robustness scores
layers.ingested_by: Consumes aggregation/defense/personalization logs + baselines & attack sets

layers.key_fields: metric defs, thresholds, mappings, centralized baselines & attack sets, versions
layers.ingested_by: Supplies formulas/thresholds & reference data to L3
layers.notes: Governs the FL RMTE overlay corpus (net-new)

layers.key_fields: DP-budget, secure-agg, poisoning, residency, attestation decisions, gates
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evaluation evidence; runs release gates

layers.key_fields: Evidence Pack manifest, RFC 6962 inclusion proofs / hashes, Trust Score (Q6)
layers.ingested_by: Assembles tamper-evident evidence + verdict

layers.key_fields: persona surfaces, scorecards, reports, notifications
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evidence & verdicts for reporting
